title: Kissed Garlicky Vietnamese Rice Pudding
description: A smooth, aerated rice pudding infused with garlicky ginger and sweet jocheong, perfect for soothing a hangover.
instructions: Rinse the jasmine rice under cold water until the water runs clear, then soak it for 30 minutes.
In a saucepan, combine the soaked rice, coconut milk, jocheong syrup, water, and a pinch of salt, and bring to a gentle boil over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice is tender and the mixture has thickened.
While the rice simmers, heat a small sauté pan over low heat, add the minced garlic and grated ginger, and cook until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Stir the garlicky ginger mixture into the rice pudding, then season with black pepper; let the flavors meld for 5 minutes off the heat.
Transfer the pudding to serving bowls, allowing it to cool to room temperature, which will further aerate the texture.
Garnish with a drizzle of jocheong syrup and a sprinkle of toasted coconut flakes if desired, and serve warm or at room temperature.
